description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository managing EmailCampaign entities, extending Spring Data JPA repositories to provide data access operations, including a custom query to find active email campaigns based on specific criteria.

classes.name: EmailCampaignRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for EmailCampaign entities, providing CRUD operations and custom query for active campaigns.

methods.name: findActiveEmailCampaigns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active EmailCampaign entities matching a report pattern, campaign type, and with a specific status.
